description: fuse is an R implementation of the Framework for Understanding Structural Errors, distributed through the cvitolo/fuse repository. It combines soil-moisture accounting with gamma routing and supplies 1,248 alternative hydrological structures, including structures derived from PRMS, Sacramento, TOPMODEL and ARNO/VIC. Catchment-average rainfall and potential evapotranspiration are inputs; simulated discharge time series are outputs. A modeller can compare structural uncertainty in river inflows used for reservoir capacity or water-supply studies. The code is portable across catchments; spatial coverage and time step depend on the supplied forcing and parameters. Source code, example inputs and a vignette are available through GitHub under GPL-3. A limitation is that this R reimplementation does not wrap the newer Fortran FUSE release, so versions and interfaces must be distinguished. No directly related catalogue record was established. The software was inspected through metadata and documentation; no catchment simulation or dependency installation was performed. The code is available free of charge under its stated licence.
